caption: Lightning flashes over a park during heavy rain, and for an instant every falling raindrop is lit against the dark.

sa.check: A park in heavy rain, dark.
For an instant the falling raindrops are lit against the dark.
The rain is heavy: many drops or streaks fill the frame.
The scene is dark again after the flash.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: the rain and the park brighten and return to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The park stays lit for the rest of the clip after the flash; or the light brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: During the flash the raindrops show as bright streaks or specks across the frame and the wet ground and leaves glint; between flashes they are dim.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the rain stays as dim as before; or the rain is lit brightly while the sky and ground stay dark; or the raindrops stay lit after the sky is dark; or the wet ground stays dull while the rain and sky are lit.

pc.expect: The rain falls downward, as streaks slanting at most with the wind, before, during and after the flash.
pc.fail: The rain rises or hangs still; or the streaks change direction at the flash; or the drops slant one way while the trees bend the other; or rain falls upward from the ground.

pc.expect: The trees, benches, paths and lamps of the park are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: Trees or benches appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or paths change route; or lamp posts move; or a person appears at the flash.

pc.expect: Trees, benches and lamp posts keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything; any bolt seen ends in the air or at the ground, not inside a tree lit like a lamp.
pc.fail: A tree changes shape or merges with another; or a bolt passes through a tree and lights its interior; or a bench morphs into another object; or the ground turns into open water.

pc.expect: The park's colours are consistent before and after: the flash whitens the scene only briefly.
pc.fail: The grass or trees change colour permanently after the flash; or the sky changes colour permanently; or the path changes colour.
